description:
Validate structured data against a Blueprint's rules BEFORE the result
    is used. Returns PASS, FAIL, or REVIEW with plain-language findings,
    repair suggestions, a determinism hash, and a re-verifiable
    certificate. Same input + same rules = same verdict, every time.

source_text.description: Optional. The text of the document the fields were extracted from. When the Blueprint has a source check, extracted values are compared against this text. It is used for the check only and is not stored
source_text.title: Source Text

structured_data.description: The document's extracted fields as key/value pairs. Keys are open by design - your Blueprint's rules define what is checked
structured_data.title: Structured Data

name: validate
